falar.pergunta: Introduce yourself.
falar.pedido: Apresente-se: diga oi, seu nome e de onde você é.
falar.modelo: Hi! My name is Bia. I'm from Brazil. Nice to meet you!

falar.pergunta: How are you today? Tell me about a friend.
falar.pedido: Diga como você está hoje e como é um amigo seu.
precisa: is para outra pessoa (He is... / She is...)
falar.modelo: I'm happy today. My friend Leo is tall and funny. We are good friends.

falar.pergunta: How old are you? How much is your phone?
falar.pedido: Diga sua idade e quanto custou algo seu.
precisa: sua idade com TO BE (I'm twenty-five)
evitar: \bi have [\w-]+ years\b
Idade em inglês usa TO BE: I'm 25, e não I have 25 years.
falar.modelo: I'm twenty-five years old. My phone cost two hundred dollars.

falar.pergunta: What do you have in your bag?
falar.pedido: Diga pelo menos três coisas que estão na sua bolsa ou mochila.
precisa: a ou an antes de uma coisa
falar.modelo: I have a phone, an umbrella and two books in my bag.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about your family.
falar.pedido: Fale da sua família: quem são e como se chamam.
falar.modelo: My mother's name is Rosa. I have a brother. His name is Leo, and his wife is Carla.

falar.pergunta: Describe your street.
falar.pedido: Descreva sua rua ou seu bairro: o que existe e onde fica.
precisa: \b(next to|near|in front of|behind|between|across from|opposite|on the corner)\b
uma preposição de lugar (next to, near...)
evitar: (^|[.!?]\s*)have (a|an|two|three|many|some|one)\b
Para dizer que algo existe, use there is/are, e não have.
falar.modelo: There is a bakery next to my house. There are two schools near the park.

falar.pergunta: Describe your daily routine.
falar.pedido: Conte como é um dia comum seu.
precisa: um verbo no presente (I get up, I work...)
falar.modelo: I usually get up at seven. I have breakfast, and then I go to work by bus. I never work on Sundays.

falar.pergunta: When do you do things?
falar.pedido: Diga uma hora, um dia e um mês em que você faz algo.
precisa: in + mês ou parte do dia
falar.modelo: I start work at nine on Mondays. My birthday is in May, and I study in the evening.

falar.pergunta: Ask a new friend three questions.
falar.pedido: Faça três perguntas para alguém que você acabou de conhecer.
precisa: uma pergunta com do you / are you
falar.modelo: What's your name? Where do you live? What do you do on weekends?

falar.pergunta: What can you do? What can't you do?
falar.pedido: Diga duas coisas que você sabe fazer e uma que não sabe.
falar.modelo: I can cook and I can swim, but I can't sing.

falar.pergunta: What do you like and hate doing?
falar.pedido: Fale do que você gosta e do que odeia fazer.
falar.modelo: I love reading and I like cooking, but I hate waking up early.

falar.pergunta: Give instructions for a simple recipe.
falar.pedido: Dê instruções para uma receita simples ou um jogo.
falar.modelo: Boil the water. Add the pasta and wait ten minutes. Don't forget the salt!

falar.pergunta: What are people around you doing right now?
falar.pedido: Descreva o que as pessoas ao seu redor estão fazendo agora.
falar.modelo: I'm sitting on the sofa. My sister is watching TV and the dog is sleeping.

falar.pergunta: What did you do last weekend?
falar.pedido: Conte o que você fez no último fim de semana.
precisa: uma expressão de tempo (last weekend, yesterday)
falar.modelo: Last weekend I visited my grandmother. We cooked lunch and watched a movie. It was great.

falar.pergunta: What is in your kitchen?
falar.pedido: Diga o que tem e o que falta na sua cozinha, usando some, any, much e many.
falar.modelo: There is some rice, but there isn't any milk. We don't have much coffee, and there aren't many eggs.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about a moment when something interrupted you.
falar.pedido: Conte um momento em que algo interrompeu o que você fazia.
falar.modelo: I was cooking dinner when the phone rang. While I was talking, the rice burned.

falar.pergunta: What are your plans for next week?
falar.pedido: Conte seus planos para a próxima semana e faça uma previsão.
falar.modelo: Next week I'm going to visit my parents. I think it will rain on Saturday.

falar.pergunta: Compare two cities.
falar.pedido: Compare duas cidades, pessoas ou coisas.
falar.modelo: São Paulo is bigger than Rio, but Rio is more beautiful. For me, Rio is the best city in Brazil.

falar.pergunta: Give advice to someone starting a new job.
falar.pedido: Dê conselhos e regras para alguém que começa num emprego novo.
falar.modelo: You should arrive early. You have to wear a badge, and you must not use your phone in meetings.

falar.pergunta: How long have you lived in your city?
falar.pedido: Diga há quanto tempo você mora onde mora e algo que já fez na vida.
precisa: present perfect (I have lived, I've been)
falar.modelo: I have lived in this city for ten years. I've never been to Japan, but I've visited Chile twice.

falar.pergunta: What was your life like when you were a child?
falar.pedido: Conte como era sua vida quando você era criança.
falar.modelo: When I was a child, I used to play football every day. I didn't use to like vegetables.

falar.pergunta: What will you do if it rains this weekend?
falar.pedido: Diga o que você vai fazer se chover no fim de semana.
precisa: will na outra parte da frase
evitar: \bif [^.,!?]*\bwill\b
Depois de if, use o presente: If it rains, e não If it will rain.
falar.modelo: If it rains this weekend, I'll stay at home and watch movies. If I have time, I'll call my friends.

falar.pergunta: Describe a person and a place that are important to you.
falar.pedido: Descreva uma pessoa e um lugar importantes para você.
falar.modelo: My aunt is the person who taught me to cook. The beach where we spent our holidays is my favorite place.

falar.pergunta: What do you want to do this year? What do you enjoy doing?
falar.pedido: Fale de algo que você quer fazer e de algo que gosta de fazer.
falar.modelo: I want to learn French this year. I enjoy traveling, but I avoid flying at night.

falar.pergunta: What would you do if you won the lottery?
falar.pedido: Diga o que você faria se ganhasse na loteria.
falar.modelo: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house by the sea. I wish I had more free time.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about something that was invented or made.
falar.pedido: Fale de algo inventado ou fabricado: onde, quando e por quem.
falar.modelo: Coffee is grown in Brazil. The telephone was invented by Bell, and this song was written in 1985.

falar.pergunta: What did a friend tell you yesterday?
falar.pedido: Conte o que um amigo disse para você ontem, sem repetir as palavras dele.
precisa: o verbo um tempo para trás (was, would, had)
falar.modelo: My friend told me that she was tired. She said she would call me later.

falar.pergunta: What had happened before you arrived? What have you been doing lately?
falar.pedido: Conte o que já tinha acontecido quando você chegou a algum lugar e o que você tem feito ultimamente.
falar.modelo: When I arrived, the movie had already started. Lately I've been studying a lot for my exams.

falar.pergunta: Describe your morning.
falar.pedido: Descreva sua manhã usando phrasal verbs.
precisa: um phrasal verb (wake up, turn off...)
falar.modelo: I wake up at six, turn off the alarm and get up. Then I put on my clothes and pick up my keys.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about a mistake you made.
falar.pedido: Fale de um erro do passado: o que você deveria ter feito.
precisa: terceira condicional (If I had..., I would have...)
falar.modelo: I should have studied more for the test. If I had studied, I would have passed.

falar.pergunta: Use false friends correctly.
falar.pedido: Use pelo menos dois falsos cognatos da lição em frases certas.
precisa: um falso cognato da lição (actually, library...)
falar.modelo: Actually, I don't like coffee. I went to the library to study, and I had lunch with my sister.

falar.pergunta: What do you think about working from home?
falar.pedido: Dê sua opinião sobre trabalhar de casa, usando although, however ou therefore.
falar.modelo: Working from home is comfortable. However, it can be lonely. Although I like it, I go to the office twice a week.

falar.pergunta: What do you really need in life?
falar.pedido: Diga o que você mais precisa na vida, com ênfase.
precisa: uma frase enfática (What I need is..., It was... who...)
falar.modelo: What I really need is more time. It was my mother who taught me that. Never have I felt so calm.

falar.pergunta: Ask your boss for a day off.
falar.pedido: Peça um dia de folga para o chefe, com educação.
precisa: \b(please|i was wondering|would it be possible|i would like|i'd like)\b
falar.modelo: I was wondering if I could take Friday off. Would it be possible to finish my report on Thursday instead?

falar.pergunta: How was your week?
falar.pedido: Conte sua semana usando make, do e take.
falar.modelo: This week I made a big decision and did a lot of exercise. Yesterday I took a long walk to relax.

falar.pergunta: Tell the story of your English so far.
falar.pedido: Conte como tem sido seu inglês até agora, com voz passiva, discurso indireto e um conector.
precisa: voz passiva (I was told, it is spoken)
falar.modelo: I was told that English was difficult. However, I kept going, and my teacher said I had improved a lot.

falar.pergunta: You are at check-in.
falar.pedido: No check-in: peça um assento na janela e diga quantas malas você vai despachar.
falar.modelo: Hi, I'm checking in for the flight to New York. Could I have a window seat, please? I have one bag to check.

falar.pergunta: Call the front desk about a problem.
falar.pedido: Ligue para a recepção: há um problema no seu quarto.
precisa: \b(problem|doesn'?t work|isn'?t working|broken|not working|there is no|there's no)\b
falar.modelo: Hello, I'm in room 405. The air conditioning isn't working. Could you send someone to fix it, please?

falar.pergunta: How do I get to the supermarket?
falar.pedido: Explique como ir da sua casa até o mercado mais próximo.
precisa: uma expressão de direção (turn left, go straight)
falar.modelo: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left at the bank. The supermarket is on the right, next to the pharmacy.

falar.pergunta: The jeans don't fit.
falar.pedido: Numa loja: a calça não serve. Explique e peça outro tamanho.
falar.modelo: These jeans are too tight, and they aren't long enough. Do you have them in a bigger size?

falar.pergunta: What's the problem?
falar.pedido: Descreva seus sintomas para o médico e diga desde quando.
precisa: o sintoma (I have a headache, my back hurts)
falar.modelo: I've had a headache since Monday, and my throat hurts. I also feel very tired.

falar.pergunta: Leave a message.
falar.pedido: Ligue para uma empresa e deixe recado para alguém que não está.
precisa: \b(could you|can you|please) (tell|ask|give)\b|\bleave a message\b|\bcall me back\b
o recado (Could you tell her...?, call me back)
falar.modelo: Hi, this is Bia from Sol Travel. Could you tell Mr. Lee that I called? He can call me back this afternoon.

falar.pergunta: Start small talk with a neighbor.
falar.pedido: Puxe conversa com um vizinho sobre o tempo ou o fim de semana.
precisa: \b(isn'?t it|aren'?t they|don'?t you|didn'?t you|wasn'?t it|haven'?t you|is it|was it|right)\b
falar.modelo: It's such a nice day, isn't it? It was so hot yesterday. You went to the beach, didn't you?

falar.pergunta: Tell me about a trip.
falar.pedido: Conte uma viagem: aonde foi e o que viu, usando a, an e the.
falar.modelo: Last year I visited a small town in the mountains. The town had an old church, and the church had a beautiful bell.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about yourself.
falar.pedido: Numa entrevista de emprego: fale da sua experiência e dos seus pontos fortes.
precisa: sua experiência (I've worked..., I have experience in...)
\b(i'm good at|i am good at|strengths?|i'm (very )?(organized|patient|creative|reliable|hardworking|responsible)|i am (very )?(organized|patient|creative|reliable|hardworking|responsible))\b
seus pontos fortes (I'm good at..., I'm organized)
falar.modelo: I've worked in sales for five years. I'm good at solving problems, and I'm very organized.

falar.pergunta: What services do you pay for?
falar.pedido: Conte o que você manda fazer (cabelo, carro, conserto) usando have ou get.
precisa: have/get + objeto + particípio (I had my car repaired)
falar.modelo: I have my hair cut every month. Last week I had my car repaired, and tomorrow I'm getting my eyes checked.

falar.pergunta: Where will you be in one year?
falar.pedido: Diga onde você estará daqui a um ano e o que já terá feito.
falar.modelo: This time next year, I'll be living in Lisbon. By then, I will have finished my course.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about your week.
falar.pedido: Fale da sua semana com palavras que têm TH e verbos no passado com -ED.
falar.modelo: I think I worked three days this week. I wanted to rest, so I played video games on Thursday.

falar.pergunta: Imagine a different past.
falar.pedido: Imagine um passado diferente: como seria sua vida hoje?
falar.modelo: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't know my best friend today.

falar.pergunta: Suggest changes to your company or school.
falar.pedido: Sugira mudanças no seu trabalho ou escola, de forma formal.
precisa: suggest, recommend ou it is essential
verbo na forma base depois de that (that everyone be...)
falar.modelo: I suggest that we start meetings on time. It is essential that everyone be informed about the changes.

falar.pergunta: What will work be like in the future?
falar.pedido: Dê uma opinião cautelosa sobre o futuro do trabalho.
precisa: linguagem cautelosa (it seems, tend to, likely)
falar.modelo: It seems that remote work is here to stay. Companies are likely to offer more flexible hours, although some might prefer the office.

falar.pergunta: Open a presentation about your city.
falar.pedido: Abra uma apresentação curta sobre a sua cidade e diga como ela vai ser organizada.
precisa: \b(today i'?m going to|today i will|today i'd like to|i'd like to talk|i would like to talk|let me start|to begin)\b
uma abertura (Today I'm going to talk about...)
falar.modelo: Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about my city. First, I'll show you its history. Then, I'll talk about the food, and finally about the people.

falar.pergunta: Respond to a colleague in a meeting.
falar.pedido: Numa reunião: concorde em parte, discorde com educação e peça um esclarecimento.
precisa: \b(i agree|you're right|good point|that's true|i see your point|fair point)\b
\b(i'm not sure|i see it differently|i'm afraid|i'm not convinced|i don't think)\b
discordar com educação (I'm not sure, I'm afraid...)
\b(what do you mean|could you clarify|could you explain|do you mean)\b
pedir esclarecimento (What do you mean by...?)
falar.modelo: I agree with you on the budget, but I'm not sure about the deadline. What do you mean by next week, exactly?

falar.pergunta: Persuade your team to try a new idea.
falar.pedido: Convença sua equipe a testar uma ideia nova, de forma formal e cautelosa.
falar.modelo: I'd recommend that we test the new app for a month. It seems likely to save time, although it might need some changes.

falar.pergunta: Say a sentence with ship and sheep.
falar.pedido: Diga uma frase com ship e sheep, e outra com full e fool.
falar.modelo: The sheep is on the ship. My glass is full, and he isn't a fool.

falar.pergunta: What are you going to do later?
falar.pedido: Diga como você está e o que vai fazer mais tarde, falando de forma natural.
precisa: going to ou want to (na fala, viram gonna e wanna)
falar.modelo: I'm doing great, thanks. I'm going to meet some friends later, and we want to grab something to eat.

falar.pergunta: A friend invites you to a party on Saturday, but you're busy. What do you say?
falar.pedido: Recuse o convite com educação, dê um motivo e sugira outro dia.
falar.modelo: Thanks for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't come on Saturday, because I'm working. How about meeting for coffee on Sunday?

falar.pergunta: What do you do in the morning before you leave home?
falar.pedido: Conte a sua manhã usando pelo menos dois phrasal verbs (wake up, get up, put on, turn off...).
precisa: quando você acorda ou levanta (wake up / get up)
outro phrasal verb (put on, turn off...)
uma ordem ou horário (first, then, at seven)
falar.modelo: I wake up at seven and I get up at quarter past. First, I put on my clothes and make coffee. Then I turn off the lights and leave home at eight.

falar.pergunta: Should students wear uniforms at school? What do you think?
falar.pedido: Dê a sua opinião, uma razão e mostre que entende o outro lado.
precisa: \b(i think|in my opinion|i reckon|i believe|personally|as far as i'?m concerned)\b
a sua opinião (In my opinion / I reckon)
\b(but|however|on the other hand|i see what you mean|it'?s true|although)\b
o outro lado (It's true that..., but...)
falar.modelo: In my opinion, students shouldn't wear uniforms, because clothes are a way to show who you are. It's true that uniforms can be cheaper for families, but I think students learn better when they feel comfortable.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about something funny or strange that happened to you.
falar.pedido: Conte a história em ordem, usando sequenciadores e o passado.
precisa: o cenário no passado contínuo (I was walking...)
falar.modelo: Last summer I was walking in the park with my dog. First, he saw a cat. Then he ran after it and jumped into the lake. Suddenly, I was in the water too! In the end, we both went home wet, but we laughed a lot.

falar.pergunta: A friend sends you a message: “Fancy a film tonight?” Reply.
falar.pedido: Responda como numa mensagem informal: aceite, combine a hora e use uma abreviação ou expressão informal.
falar.modelo: Sure, sounds good! Shall we meet at 7 at the cinema? BTW, I'll buy the popcorn. Cheers!

falar.pergunta: What's a film, series or book you'd recommend? Why?
falar.pedido: Diga onde se passa ou sobre o que é, e por que vale a pena, sem contar o final.
precisa: onde se passa ou sobre o que é (It's set in / It's about)
falar.modelo: I'd recommend Paddington 2. It's set in London and it's about a bear who looks for a present for his aunt. It's worth watching because it's funny and kind, and the cast is brilliant.

falar.pergunta: What did you use to do when you were a child?
falar.pedido: Conte hábitos da sua infância com used to e would.
falar.modelo: When I was a child, I used to live near the sea. Every weekend, my family would go to the beach, and my dad would always buy ice cream. I used to have a lot of friends there.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about a person or a place that is important to you.
falar.pedido: Use pelo menos duas orações explicativas, com who, which, whose ou where.
precisa: uma oração explicativa (who, which, whose, where)
falar.modelo: My grandmother, who is eighty, lives in a small town where everybody knows her. Her house, which has a big garden, is my favourite place in the world.

falar.pergunta: Tell me about a time you prepared too much for something.
falar.pedido: Use needn't have e um pouco de linguagem vaga (sort of, or so, -ish).
falar.modelo: Last year I studied for a test for twenty hours or so. In the end, it was sort of easy, so I needn't have studied that much. I needn't have worried either!

falar.pergunta: Should children learn to use technology at school from an early age?
falar.pedido: Dê a sua opinião usando vocabulário de escola e de tecnologia.
precisa: a sua opinião (I think / In my opinion)
falar.modelo: I think children should learn to use technology at school, because most jobs need it today. For example, coding lessons teach logic. However, teachers should also limit screen time, because children need to play and read books too.

falar.pergunta: Look back at this arc. What can you do now in English that you couldn't do before?
falar.pedido: Fale de pelo menos duas coisas que você aprendeu, com um exemplo.
precisa: \b(i can|i'?m able to|now i|i learned|i'?ve learned|i learnt|i'?ve learnt)\b
o que você consegue agora (I can / I've learned)
falar.modelo: Now I can invite people and make suggestions, for example: How about going to the cinema? I've also learned to tell a story with first, then and in the end, and I can talk about the films I like.

escrever.pedido: Escreva uma mensagem para um novo colega de curso. Diga seu nome, sua idade, de onde você é e fale da sua família. Cerca de 30 palavras.
evitar: \bi have [\w-]+ years\b
Idade usa TO BE: I'm 30, e não I have 30 years.
escrever.modelo: Hi! My name is Bia and I'm twenty-eight years old. I'm from Recife, in Brazil. I live with my husband and our son, Theo. I have a sister, Luana. She is a teacher. See you in class!

escrever.pedido: Escreva sobre um dia comum da sua semana e sobre o que você gosta de fazer no tempo livre. Cerca de 40 palavras.
precisa: verbos no presente (I get up, I work)
at, on ou in com hora ou dia
escrever.modelo: I usually get up at six thirty. I have coffee and go to work by bus. I work from nine to five. In the evening, I cook dinner with my family. On weekends, I love walking in the park and I like watching movies.

escrever.pedido: Escreva um e-mail para um amigo contando o que você fez nas últimas férias e o que vai fazer nas próximas. Cerca de 60 palavras.
escrever.modelo:
Hi Leo,
How are you? Last July I went to Salvador with my sister. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach, and we ate a lot of delicious food. It was hot and sunny every day! Next year I'm going to visit Chile. I think it will be cold, but I want to see the mountains.
See you soon,
Bia

escrever.pedido: Escreva um e-mail para um amigo (cerca de 100 palavras, como no B1 Preliminary). Você se mudou para outra cidade: diga há quanto tempo, como era sua vida antes e dê um conselho para quem quer se mudar.
escrever.modelo:
Hi Carla,
I'm sorry I haven't written for so long! I have lived in Curitiba since March, and I love it. I used to live in a very noisy street in São Paulo, and I used to spend two hours a day on the bus. Now I walk to work in fifteen minutes. I've made some new friends at the gym, and we often go hiking together.
If you want to move too, you should visit the city first and talk to people who live there. You shouldn't decide too quickly.
Write soon,
Bia

escrever.pedido: Escreva um ensaio de opinião (140 a 190 palavras, como no B2 First): Todos os alunos deveriam aprender uma segunda língua na escola? Use as ideias "trabalho" e "viagens" e mais uma sua.
precisa: \b(in my opinion|i believe|i think|from my point of view|personally)\b
\b(in conclusion|to sum up|all in all|to conclude)\b
escrever.modelo:
Should every student learn a second language at school? In my opinion, the answer is yes, for several reasons.
Firstly, a second language opens doors at work. Many companies look for people who can speak to clients from other countries, and candidates who speak English are often paid better.
Secondly, languages make travel easier and more meaningful. If you can talk to local people, you understand their culture instead of just visiting places.
Moreover, learning a language trains the brain. Students learn to notice patterns and to express the same idea in different ways, which helps in other subjects too.
On the other hand, some people argue that schools already have too many subjects, and that students should focus on maths and their own language. Although this is a fair point, a few hours of language classes a week would not take time away from other subjects.
In conclusion, I believe that a second language should be part of every school curriculum, because it prepares students for work, travel and life.

escrever.pedido: Escreva um e-mail formal para uma loja: o produto que você comprou chegou com defeito. Explique o problema e peça o reembolso. Cerca de 120 palavras, sem contrações.
evitar: \b(don't|can't|won't|isn't|wasn't|didn't|doesn't|i'm|it's|i've|i'd)\b
Em e-mail formal, evite contrações: I am, it is, do not.
escrever.modelo:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to complain about a coffee machine that I ordered from your website on 3 October (order number 48213).
Unfortunately, when the machine arrived, the water tank was cracked and the machine did not turn on. I followed the instructions carefully, and I am certain that the damage happened before delivery. Furthermore, I contacted your customer service twice, but I have not received any reply.
I would therefore be grateful if you could refund the full amount of 89 euros. I am happy to return the machine, provided that you send me a prepaid label.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours faithfully,
Beatriz Souza

escrever.pedido: Escreva uma avaliação de um hotel em que você ficou (cerca de 100 palavras): o quarto, o atendimento, um problema e se você recomenda.
escrever.modelo: I stayed at the Blue Bay Hotel for three nights in August. The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable, but it was too small for two people, and the Wi-Fi wasn't fast enough to work. The staff were friendly and helpful. When the air conditioning stopped working, they fixed it in less than an hour. Breakfast was the best part: fresh fruit, eggs and great coffee. The hotel is a bit expensive, but the location is perfect, just five minutes from the beach. I would recommend it, especially to couples.

escrever.pedido: Escreva um resumo de uma reunião para um colega que faltou (cerca de 120 palavras): o que foi decidido, quem discordou e quais são os próximos passos.
precisa: as decisões (it was agreed, we decided)
quem disse o quê (argued, pointed out)
escrever.modelo:
Hi Marcos,
Here is a quick summary of today's meeting. It was agreed that the launch will be postponed to June, mainly because the new app still needs testing. Carla disagreed and argued that a delay might affect our sales, but most of the team felt it was safer to wait. Jin pointed out that the budget seems to be under control, so the delay is unlikely to cost us more.
The next steps are: Carla will update the marketing plan by Friday, Jin will review the budget next week, and we will meet again on 12 May.
Let me know if you have any questions.
Best,
Bia

escrever.pedido: Você está de férias. Escreva um cartão-postal para um amigo: onde você está, como é o lugar, o que você fez ontem e o que vai fazer amanhã. Cerca de 50 palavras.
precisa: o plano para amanhã (tomorrow / going to)
escrever.modelo: Hi Leo! I'm in Lisbon with my sister. It's a beautiful city with old streets and lots of hills. Yesterday we visited a castle and ate fresh fish by the river. Tomorrow we're going to take a train to the beach. Wish you were here! See you soon, Ana

escrever.pedido: Descreva o seu melhor amigo ou a sua melhor amiga: como a pessoa é, do que ela gosta e por que vocês são amigos. Cerca de 50 palavras.
escrever.modelo: My best friend is Carla. She is tall and she has short black hair. She is very funny and kind. She likes music and she loves cooking. We met at school when we were ten. We are best friends because she always listens to me and she makes me laugh.

escrever.pedido: Você comprou um fone de ouvido pela internet e ele chegou quebrado. Escreva um e-mail para a loja: explique o problema, diga quando comprou e peça a troca ou o reembolso. Cerca de 80 palavras.
precisa: o problema (it's broken / it doesn't work)
o que você quer (a refund / a replacement)
evitar: \b(gonna|wanna)\b
Num e-mail para uma empresa, evite gonna e wanna.
escrever.modelo:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing about some headphones that I ordered from your website on 2 March. They arrived yesterday, but unfortunately they are broken: the left side doesn't work at all. I have attached a photo of the problem. Could you please send me a replacement, or give me a full refund? I would prefer a replacement if possible.
Thank you for your help.
Kind regards,
Ana Lima

escrever.titulo: O dia em que tudo deu errado
escrever.pedido: Conte a história de um dia em que tudo deu errado (verdadeiro ou inventado). Use sequência e tempos do passado. Cerca de 100 palavras.
precisa: o cenário no passado contínuo (I was walking...)
escrever.modelo: Last Monday was a disaster. First, my alarm didn't go off, so I woke up an hour late. Then I couldn't find my keys anywhere. After that, I ran to the bus stop, but the bus had already left. While I was waiting for the next one, it started to rain, and of course I didn't have an umbrella. Suddenly, a car drove through a puddle and soaked my trousers. When I finally arrived at work, I discovered that the meeting had been cancelled. In the end, I laughed about it with my colleagues and went home early.

escrever.pedido: Escreva uma avaliação de um restaurante, café ou loja que você conhece: o que é bom, o que poderia melhorar e se você recomenda. Cerca de 80 palavras.
escrever.modelo: I often go to Café Aurora, a small café near my office. The coffee is excellent and the cakes are home-made, especially the carrot cake, which is delicious. The staff are friendly and always remember my order. However, it can get very crowded at lunchtime, and there aren't many tables, so sometimes I have to take my coffee away. The prices are reasonable for the quality. Overall, I'd definitely recommend it, but go early if you want a seat.

escrever.pedido: Escreva uma carta de apresentação para uma vaga de atendimento num hotel internacional: sua experiência, suas qualidades com exemplo e por que você quer a vaga. Entre 120 e 160 palavras.
precisa: que você está se candidatando (I am writing to apply...)
o encerramento (I look forward to hearing from you)
evitar: \b(gonna|wanna|gotta)\b
Em carta formal, evite gonna, wanna e gotta.
\b(i'm|don't|can't|won't|it's|i've)\b
Em carta formal, prefira as formas completas: I am, do not, cannot.
escrever.modelo:
Dear Ms Taylor,
I am writing to apply for the position of receptionist advertised on your website. I have been working in customer service for three years, most recently at a busy hotel in Rio de Janeiro, where I dealt with guests from many different countries.
I am organised, patient and calm under pressure. For example, during a system failure last summer, I checked in more than forty guests manually and made sure that every one of them received the correct room.
I would particularly like to work for your hotel because of its reputation for excellent service and its international team. I speak Portuguese, English and some Spanish, and I am keen to continue developing my languages.
I have attached my CV and would be happy to provide references. I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours sincerely,
Ana Lima

escrever.pedido: A prefeitura pediu um relatório curto sobre o transporte público do seu bairro: situação atual, problemas principais e duas recomendações. Use títulos. Entre 120 e 160 palavras.
evitar: \b(gonna|wanna|gotta)\b
Em relatório, evite gonna, wanna e gotta.
escrever.modelo:
Introduction
The aim of this report is to describe public transport in the Vila Nova area and to make recommendations for improvement.
Current situation
The area is served by two bus routes and one metro station. Buses run every twenty minutes during the day, but only once an hour after 10 p.m.
Main problems
The main issue is overcrowding at peak times, when many passengers cannot get on the first bus. In addition, there is no direct route to the hospital, which is a serious problem for elderly residents.
Recommendations
Firstly, I recommend increasing the frequency of buses between 7 and 9 a.m. Secondly, the council should consider a new route connecting the station to the hospital.
Conclusion
Overall, public transport in the area is reasonable, but these two changes would make a significant difference to residents' daily lives.

escrever.pedido: Escreva uma proposta para a diretoria da sua empresa sugerindo um programa de bem-estar para os funcionários: o problema, a proposta, os custos e os benefícios esperados. Entre 160 e 200 palavras.
precisa: o problema com dados ou contexto
evitar: \b(gonna|wanna|gotta|stuff|kinda)\b
Num texto formal, evite gonna, wanna, stuff e kinda.
escrever.modelo:
Introduction
The purpose of this proposal is to recommend a staff wellbeing programme for the coming year.
The problem
According to our recent staff survey, 46% of employees report feeling stressed at least three days a week, and sick leave has risen by 12% since last year. This is affecting both morale and productivity.
The proposal
I propose a programme with three elements: a weekly yoga or stretching session during lunchtime, access to a confidential counselling service, and a clear policy discouraging emails after 7 p.m. Furthermore, managers would receive short training on recognising signs of burnout.
Costs
The total cost is estimated at £18,000 per year, mainly for the counselling service and the instructor. This represents a modest investment compared with the cost of replacing experienced staff.
Expected benefits
Similar programmes in other companies have been shown to reduce sick leave and improve retention. In addition, they would strengthen our reputation as a responsible employer.
Conclusion
In conclusion, I recommend approving a six-month pilot, after which its impact can be evaluated through a follow-up survey.

mediar.texto: Comprei o produto há 3 semanas e até agora não chegou. Quero meu dinheiro de volta!
